mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as waiting_orders, coalesce(sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as delivered_orders, coalesce(sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completed_orders, coalesce(sum(case when status = 6 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelled_orders, count(id) as all_orders from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < #{end}
select coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sold, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as discontinued from dish
select coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sold, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as discontinued from setmeal
